descriptionEn: Official Second Secondary 2026/2027 novel: an exhilarating scientific expedition deep into an uncharted South American plateau where prehistoric creatures still survive.
plotSummaryEn: The Lost World tells the story of Edward Malone, a young reporter who wants to prove his bravery to Gladys. He joins an expedition led by Professor Challenger, who claims prehistoric animals survive on an isolated plateau in South America. Alongside Professor Summerlee and explorer Lord John Roxton, they navigate the Amazon, are betrayed and trapped on the plateau by Gomez, encounter dinosaurs and ape-men, and ultimately prove the extraordinary truth.

characters.name: Edward Malone (إدوارد مالون)
characters.descriptionEn: A 23-year-old ambitious reporter who seeks danger to prove his bravery, discovering that true courage is about helping others rather than seeking personal approval.
characters.descriptionAr: صحفي شاب طموح يبحث عن المغامرة، ويتعلم خلال الرحلة أن الشجاعة الحقيقية هي مواجهة الخطر لإنقاذ الآخرين واكتشاف الذات.

characters.name: Professor George Edward Challenger (البروفيسور تشالنجر)
characters.descriptionEn: A proud, brilliant, hot-tempered scientist whose unyielding determination leads the expedition to the plateau.
characters.descriptionAr: عالم حيوان عبقري وعريض البنية وفخور، قاده إصراره ومعرفته العلمية لإثبات وجود مخلوقات ما قبل التاريخ.

characters.name: Professor Summerlee (البروفيسور سمرلي)

characters.name: Lord John Roxton (اللورد جون روكستون)
characters.descriptionEn: A brave, cool-headed explorer with deep knowledge of the Amazon whose practical survival skills save the team repeatedly.
characters.descriptionAr: صياد ومستكشف شجاع وهادئ الأعصاب، يمتلك خبرة عميقة بغابات وأنهار الأمازون ساهمت في نجاة البعثة.

characters.name: Zambo (زامبو)
characters.descriptionEn: A strong, faithful man who remains below the plateau, maintaining supplies and communication when the explorers are trapped.
characters.descriptionAr: رجل قوي ومرح وشديد الوفاء، رابط أسفل الهضبة وأمدهم بالطعام والذخيرة طوال فترة حصارهم.

characters.name: Gomez (جوميز)
